candidate_universe.primary: candidate_parse_status=valid AND worker_id not in c1_canonicalization_summary.excluded_worker_ids AND eligible_for_geometry_loo=true AND normalize_geometry valid

development_replay.locked_subset: 4-building A4-specific locked subset is not a virgin confirmation set
development_replay.outer_scheme: building-disjoint nested/LOBO; estimate any variant choice only in outer-train; evaluate outer-test once

future_effect_gates_not_evaluated.direction_gate: at least 6/9 buildings non-negative and at least 5/9 strictly positive
future_effect_gates_not_evaluated.selection_rule: no max-observed selection; outer LOBO only; ties A4-S; A4-S retained as primary safety estimate

variants.A4-C: A4-S cluster choice; highest candidate image score within cluster; image ties use full_cluster_formal_medoid_ranking; fallback A0
variants.A4-L: A0 largest cluster fixed; rerank candidates by image score; image ties use full_cluster_formal_medoid_ranking; fallback A0
variants.A4-S: unique partition; clusters support>=2; median of four per-pool normalized mid-ranks; median cluster score; ties support then formal medoid; fallback A0
